method: Original directed OpenStreetMap coastlines define physical land without simplification. Only Shanghai and Zhoushan display coverage changes. Existing shared administrative edges and Chongming’s Shanghai/Jiangsu split remain fixed. Whole physical islands replace coarse components when one existing jurisdiction or an unambiguous official island checkpoint establishes ownership. Islands shared with other jurisdictions retain the existing administrative partition. Source bounding-box edges never become display shorelines.

nanhuiShore.provider: OpenStreetMap coastal wetland and harbor-access geometry
nanhuiShore.imagery: EOxCloudless Sentinel-2 2025, same alignment as the satellite layer
nanhuiShore.processing: Nanhui mainland display follows the landward edge of the mapped coastal wetlands along the seawall. Exposed tidal flats and tidal training dikes are excluded from the land fill. The raised harbor access retains its mapped footprint. Only Pudong display geometry changes; administrative inland boundaries and Dishui Lake remain unchanged.
